  const ENTER_START_VH = isMobile ? 0.50 : 0.60;
  const ENTER_END_VH   = isMobile ? 1.00 : 0.90;
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function init() {
    const scroller = document.getElementById(SCROLL_ID);
    if (!scroller) return;

    const buildings = Array.from(
      scroller.querySelectorAll('[data-building]')
    ).sort((a, b) => Number(a.dataset.building) - Number(b.dataset.building));

    const total = buildings.length;
    if (total === 0) return;

    const revealOrder = [...buildings].reverse();

    // INIT: ensure all start hidden, let CSS transition handle the animation
    revealOrder.forEach(b => {
      b.classList.remove('is-revealed');
      b.style.opacity   = '';
      b.style.transform = '';
    });

    const revealed = new Array(total).fill(false);

    function clamp(val, min, max) {
      return Math.min(Math.max(val, min), max);
    }

    function onScroll() {
      const vh       = window.innerHeight;
      const rect     = scroller.getBoundingClientRect();
      const pos      = rect.top / vh;
      const sectionH = scroller.offsetHeight;

      const enterStart = ENTER_START_VH;
      const enterEnd   = ENTER_END_VH - (sectionH / vh);

      revealOrder.forEach((building, i) => {
        const staggerOffset = i * STAGGER;
        const bStart = enterStart - staggerOffset;
        const bEnd   = enterEnd   - staggerOffset;

        const shouldReveal = pos <= bStart;

        if (shouldReveal && !revealed[i]) {
          revealed[i] = true;
          building.classList.add('is-revealed');
        } else if (!shouldReveal && revealed[i]) {
          revealed[i] = false;
          building.classList.remove('is-revealed');
        }
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }

})();

<script>

(function rollNumbers({
  selector = '.span-number',
  duration = 1.4,
  ease = 'power4.out',
  delay = 0.15
} = {}) {
  
  function createStack(finalDigit, isUp) {
    const wrapper = document.createElement('span');
    wrapper.className = `span-roll-wrapper ${isUp ? 'up' : 'down'}`;
    wrapper.style.cssText = 'display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;';
    
    const stack = document.createElement('span');
    stack.className = 'span-roll-stack';
    stack.style.cssText = 'display:block;will-change:transform;';
    
    // Генерируем 4 случайные цифры
    const randomDigits = Array.from({length: 3}, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 10));
    const digits = isUp 
      ? [...randomDigits, parseInt(finalDigit)]
      : [parseInt(finalDigit), ...randomDigits];
    
    digits.forEach(d => {
      const el = document.createElement('span');
      el.textContent = d;
      el.style.cssText = 'display:block;line-height:1;';
      stack.appendChild(el);
    });
    
    wrapper.appendChild(stack);
    return { wrapper, stack, isUp };
  }
  
  function updatePositions(items) {
    items.forEach(item => {
      const firstChild = item.stack.children[0];
      const digitHeight = firstChild.getBoundingClientRect().height;
      const count = item.stack.children.length;
      
  
      item.wrapper.style.height = `${digitHeight}px`;
      
  
      item.finalY = item.isUp ? -(count - 1) * digitHeight : 0;
      
   
      if (item._played) {
        gsap.set(item.stack, { y: item.finalY });
      } else {
    
        const startY = item.isUp ? 0 : -(count - 1) * digitHeight;
        gsap.set(item.stack, { y: startY });
      }
    });
  }
  
  function init() {
    const spans = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector))
      .filter(s => /^\d$/.test(s.textContent.trim()));
    
    const items = spans.map((span, idx) => {
      const finalDigit = span.textContent.trim();
      const isUp = (idx % 2 === 1);
      const { wrapper, stack } = createStack(finalDigit, isUp);
      
      span.replaceWith(wrapper);
      
      return { wrapper, stack, isUp, _played: false };
    });
    
  
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      updatePositions(items);
      
    
      const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          const item = items.find(i => i.wrapper === entry.target);
          if (!item || item._played || !entry.isIntersecting) return;
          
          item._played = true;
          setTimeout(() => {
            gsap.to(item.stack, { 
              y: item.finalY, 
              duration, 
              ease,
              force3D: true
            });
          }, delay * 1000);
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.5 });
      
      items.forEach(i => io.observe(i.wrapper));
    });
    
 
    let resizeTimeout;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
      resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        updatePositions(items);
      }, 100); // Debounce 100ms
    });
  }
  
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
    document.fonts.ready.then(() => {
      setTimeout(init, 100);
    });
  } else {
    window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(init, 100));
  }
})();



</script>

<script>

  
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const menuContainer = document.querySelector('.nav_menu');
  const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.nav_dropdown');
  const background = document.querySelector('.nav_menu-background');
  let timeoutId;

  if (!menuContainer || !dropdowns.length || !background) {
    return;
  }

 
  const clearTimeoutHandler = () => clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  
  const handleMouseEnter = (event) => {
 
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    timeoutId = null;

    const dropdown = event.currentTarget;
    dropdowns.forEach(d => d.classList.remove('is-active'));
    dropdown.classList.add('is-active');

    const contentWrapper = dropdown.querySelector('.list-content-wrapper');
    if (contentWrapper) {
      const contentHeight = contentWrapper.offsetHeight;
  
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        background.style.height = `${contentHeight}px`;
        background.style.opacity = '1';
      });
    }
  };

  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
  
    if (timeoutId) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    }
    
    timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
      dropdowns.forEach(d => d.classList.remove('is-active'));
     
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        background.style.height = '0px';
        background.style.opacity = '0';
      });
    }, 200);
  };

  const setupDesktopNav = () => {
    dropdowns.forEach(dropdown => {
      dropdown.addEventListener('mouseenter', handleMouseEnter);
      dropdown.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
    });
    
    menuContainer.addEventListener('mouseenter', clearTimeoutHandler);
    menuContainer.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
  };

  const teardownDesktopNav = () => {
   
    if (timeoutId) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      timeoutId = null;
    }
    
    dropdowns.forEach(dropdown => {
      dropdown.removeEventListener('mouseenter', handleMouseEnter);
      dropdown.removeEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
    });
    
    menuContainer.removeEventListener('mouseenter', clearTimeoutHandler);
    menuContainer.removeEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
    
    
    dropdowns.forEach(d => d.classList.remove('is-active'));
    background.style.height = '0px';
    background.style.opacity = '0';
  };

  let isDesktop = window.innerWidth > 991;

  if (isDesktop) {
    setupDesktopNav();
  }


  let resizeTimeout;
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
    resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      const newIsDesktop = window.innerWidth > 991;
      if (newIsDesktop === isDesktop) return;

      isDesktop = newIsDesktop;
      if (isDesktop) {
        setupDesktopNav();
      } else {
        teardownDesktopNav();
      }
    }, 100);
  });


  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    if (timeoutId) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    }
    if (resizeTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
    }
  });
});
  
  
</script>

<script>
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            const speed = 5000; // Autoplay speed in milliseconds
            
            document.querySelectorAll(".carousel-wrapper").forEach(carouselWrapper => {
                const links = carouselWrapper.querySelectorAll(".carousel-link");
                const cards = carouselWrapper.querySelectorAll(".carousel_cms-item");
                
                // Check if required elements exist
                if (!links.length || !cards.length) {
                    console.warn("Carousel elements not found");
                    return;
                }
                
                let current = 0;
                let interval = null;
                let autoplayActive = false;
                
                // Set progress bar width with optional transition
                const setBarWidth = (index, width, transition = "none") => {
                    const bar = links[index]?.querySelector(".carousel-progress-fill");
                    if (!bar) return;
                    bar.style.transition = transition;
                    bar.style.width = width;
                };
                
                // Reset all progress bars to 0%
                const resetAllBars = () => {
                    links.forEach((_, i) => setBarWidth(i, "0%"));
                };
                
                // Update active link styling
                const updateActiveLink = (index) => {
                    links.forEach(link => link.classList.remove("is-active"));
                    if (links[index]) {
                        links[index].classList.add("is-active");
                    }
                };
                
                // Filter and show cards based on category
                
                const filterCards = (category) => {
                    const cat = category.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    
                    cards.forEach(card => {
                        const tags = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll(".category-tag"))
                            .map(tag => tag.textContent.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' '));
        
                        card.style.display = tags.includes(cat) ? "block" : "none";
                    });
                };
              
                // Animate progress bar from 0% to 100%
                const animateProgressBar = (index) => {
                    // Reset to 0% without transition
                    setBarWidth(index, "0%");
                    // Force reflow to ensure the reset takes effect
                    if (links[index]) {
                        void links[index].offsetWidth;
                        // Animate to 100%
                        setBarWidth(index, "100%", `width ${speed}ms linear`);
                    }
                };
                
                // Change to a specific slide
                const changeSlide = (newIndex, userInitiated = false) => {
                    // Validate index
                    if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= links.length) return;
                    
                    resetAllBars();
                    current = newIndex;
                    updateActiveLink(current);
                    
                    const targetCategory = links[current].dataset.target;
                    if (targetCategory) {
                        filterCards(targetCategory);
                    }
                    
                    if (userInitiated) {
                        // User clicked - set bar to 100% immediately
                        setBarWidth(current, "100%");
                    } else if (autoplayActive) {
                        // Autoplay - animate the progress bar
                        animateProgressBar(current);
                    }
                };
                
                // Start autoplay functionality
                const startAutoplay = () => {
                    if (autoplayActive || !links.length) return;
                    
                    autoplayActive = true;
                    changeSlide(current, false);
                    
                    interval = setInterval(() => {
                        const nextIndex = (current + 1) % links.length;
                        changeSlide(nextIndex, false);
                    }, speed);
                };
                
                // Stop autoplay functionality
                const stopAutoplay = () => {
                    if (!autoplayActive) return;
                    
                    autoplayActive = false;
                    if (interval) {
                        clearInterval(interval);
                        interval = null;
                    }
                    // Set current bar to 100% when stopping
                    setBarWidth(current, "100%");
                };
                
                // Add click event listeners to navigation links
                links.forEach((link, index) => {
                    link.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        stopAutoplay();
                        changeSlide(index, true);
                    });
                });
                
                // Intersection Observer for autoplay when in viewport
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            startAutoplay();
                        } else {
                            stopAutoplay();
                        }
                    });
                }, {
                    root: null,
                    rootMargin: "0px",
                    threshold: 0.1
                });
                
                // Initialize carousel
                if (links.length > 0) {
                    updateActiveLink(current);
                    const initialCategory = links[current].dataset.target;
                    if (initialCategory) {
                        filterCards(initialCategory);
                    }
                    resetAllBars();
                }
                
                // Start observing the carousel wrapper
                observer.observe(carouselWrapper);
            });
        });
    </script>

<!-- Global horizontal-border intersection fix.
     Patches any wide element drawing only a horizontal border (top/bottom, no sides)
     by redrawing it as an inset pseudo-element. Prevents 1px visual overlap with
     vertical .container-borders site-wide. Works on any dark or light section. -->
<script>
(function () {
  function patchHorizontalLines() {
    document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.hasAttribute('data-hline-patched')) return;

      const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
      const bt = parseFloat(cs.borderTopWidth);
      const bb = parseFloat(cs.borderBottomWidth);
      const bl = parseFloat(cs.borderLeftWidth);
      const br = parseFloat(cs.borderRightWidth);

      const hasHorizontal = bt > 0 || bb > 0;
      const hasVertical = bl > 0 || br > 0;
      if (!hasHorizontal || hasVertical) return;

      if (el.getBoundingClientRect().width < 200) return;

      el.setAttribute('data-hline-patched', '');
      if (cs.position === 'static') el.style.position = 'relative';

      if (bt > 0) {
        el.style.setProperty('--hline-top-color', cs.borderTopColor);
        el.style.borderTopColor = 'transparent';
      }
      if (bb > 0) {
        el.style.setProperty('--hline-bottom-color', cs.borderBottomColor);
        el.style.borderBottomColor = 'transparent';
      }
    });
  }

  function init() {
    patchHorizontalLines();

    let scheduled = false;
    const mo = new MutationObserver(function () {
      if (scheduled) return;
      scheduled = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        patchHorizontalLines();
        scheduled = false;
      });
    });
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>

<style>
  [data-hline-patched]::before,
  [data-hline-patched]::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 1px;
    right: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  [data-hline-patched]::before {
    top: -1px;
    background: var(--hline-top-color, transparent);
  }
  [data-hline-patched]::after {
    bottom: -1px;

  }

  AI ANALYTICS — CLICK + AUTO-CYCLE TAB ANIMATION
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  WHAT IT DOES
  ------------
  Click-driven AND auto-cycling tabs on the AI Analytics page. Users can click
  any tab to switch, and tabs also auto-advance on a timer. The progress bar
  on the active tab fills over the cycle duration; when it reaches 100%, the
  next tab opens. Clicking a tab resets the timer.

  Runs on BOTH tab instances on the page:
    - instance "A"  → IDs with no suffix   (#tab-panel, #tab-link-1, …)
    - instance "B"  → IDs ending in "b"     (#tab-panelb, #tab-link-1b, …)

  DESKTOP ONLY (≥992px)
  ---------------------
  Handled by gsap.matchMedia(). The 4 images (#tab-panel-content-1..4)
  crossfade in a stacked grid as you step through tabs.

  TUNABLE CONFIG
  --------------
    CYCLE_SEC = 5      Seconds per tab before auto-advancing. The progress bar
                       fills linearly over this duration.
                       → Higher = slower, more reading time per tab.
                       → Lower  = faster cycling.

    DDUR = 0.5         Accordion open/close duration (text detail + mobile image).
    FDUR = 0.45        Desktop image crossfade duration.
    EASE = 'power2.out'   GSAP easing for all transitions.

  ENVIRONMENT FIXES baked in (don't remove)

  1. overflow-x:clip on .page-wrapper (horizontal-scroll guard).

  3. tab-border-fix style: restores top/bottom borders.
  4. Webflow native tab nuke: clones menu to strip pre-attached
     Webflow listeners, removes data-tabs so Webflow JS can't re-bind.

  DEPENDENCIES
  ------------
  GSAP + gsap.matchMedia (already loaded on this page).

  IDs EXPECTED (per instance; append "b" for the second)
  ------------------------------------------------------
    #tab-panel                  the panel
    #tab-panel-img-holder       desktop image grid
    #auto-tab-mobile            tab menu (native clicks blocked)
    #tab-link-1..N              tab link wrappers (dim/active opacity)
    #tab-link-details-1..N      text detail accordions
    #tab-mobile-details-1..N    mobile image accordions
    #tab-panel-content-1..N     desktop crossfade images
    #tab-progress-wrapper-1..N  progress bar wrappers
    #tab-progress-fill-1..N     progress bar fills (width animated)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-->
<script>
  (function init() {
    if (!window.matchMedia('(min-width: 992px)').matches) return;
    if (typeof gsap === 'undefined' || document.readyState === 'loading') {
      return setTimeout(init, 50);
    }

    /* ── Horizontal-scroll guard ── */
    var pw = document.querySelector('.page-wrapper');
    if (pw) {
      pw.style.setProperty('overflow-x', 'clip', 'important');
    }

    /* ── Border fix ── */
    if (!document.getElementById('tab-border-fix')) {
      var bc = document.createElement('style');
      bc.id = 'tab-border-fix';
      bc.textContent = '.auto-tabs.cc-ai-analytics{border-top-color:var(--_v2-colors---neutral--100)!important;border-bottom-color:var(--_v2-colors---neutral--100)!important;}';
      document.head.appendChild(bc);
    }

    /* ── Tunable config ── */
    var CYCLE_SEC = 5;
    var DDUR = 0.5,
      FDUR = 0.45,
      EASE = 'power2.out';

    function setup(sx) {
      var q = function (id) {
        return document.querySelector('#' + id + sx);
      };
      var panel = q('tab-panel');
      if (!panel) return;

      /* ── Count tabs ── */
      var N = 0;
      while (document.querySelector('#tab-link-' + (N + 1) + sx)) N++;
      if (!N) return;

      var qN = function (id) {
        var a = [];
        for (var i = 1; i <= N; i++) a.push(document.querySelector('#' + id + i + sx));
        return a;
      };

      /* ── Clone menu to nuke all Webflow-attached listeners ── */
      var menuOrig = q('auto-tab-mobile');
      var menu = null;
      if (menuOrig) {
        menu = menuOrig.cloneNode(true);
        menuOrig.parentNode.replaceChild(menu, menuOrig);

        /* Remove only the top-level data-tabs attribute so Webflow JS
           can't recognise this as a tab component on re-init.
           All classes and child data-w-tab attributes stay intact
           so Webflow CSS continues to style everything correctly. */
        menu.removeAttribute('data-tabs');
        menu.removeAttribute('data-w-id');
      }

      /* ── Re-query everything from the fresh DOM ── */
      var links = qN('tab-link-'),
        details = qN('tab-link-details-'),
        mob = qN('tab-mobile-details-');
      var img = q('tab-panel-img-holder'),
        panes = qN('tab-panel-content-');
      var wraps = qN('tab-progress-wrapper-'),
        fills = qN('tab-progress-fill-');
      if (
        !img ||
        links.some(function (e) {
          return !e;
        }) ||
        details.some(function (e) {
          return !e;
        }) ||
        panes.some(function (e) {
          return !e;
        })
      )
        return;

      // ★ grab each tab-link's chevron so we can rotate it with the active state
      var chevrons = links.map(function (l) {
        return l ? l.querySelector('[data-agave="about_tab-chevron"]') : null;
      });

      var cur = -1,
        fillTween = null,
        built = false;

      /* ── Switch active tab (animations) ── */
      function activate(idx) {
        if (idx === cur) return;
        cur = idx;

        details.forEach(function (d, i) {
          if (i === idx) {
            gsap.set(d, { height: 'auto' });
            var h = d.offsetHeight;
            gsap.set(d, { height: 0 });
            gsap.to(d, {
              height: h,
              opacity: 1,
              duration: DDUR,
              ease: EASE,
              overwrite: true,
              onComplete: function () {
                gsap.set(d, { height: 'auto' });
              },
            });
          } else {
            gsap.to(d, { height: 0, opacity: 0, duration: DDUR, ease: EASE, overwrite: true });
          }
        });

        links.forEach(function (l, i) {
          gsap.to(l, { opacity: i === idx ? 1 : 0.4, duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, overwrite: true });
        });

        panes.forEach(function (p, i) {
          gsap.set(p, { opacity: i === idx ? 1 : 0 });
        });

        // ★ rotate the active tab's chevron 180deg, reset the others
        chevrons.forEach(function (ch, i) {
          if (ch) gsap.to(ch, { rotation: i === idx ? 180 : 0, duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, overwrite: true });
        });
      }

      /* ── Progress bar + auto-cycle ── */
      function startCycle() {
        stopCycle();
        fills.forEach(function (f, i) {
          if (f) gsap.set(f, { width: i < cur ? '100%' : '0%' });
        });
        if (fills[cur]) {
          fillTween = gsap.to(fills[cur], {
            width: '100%',
            duration: CYCLE_SEC,
            ease: 'none',
            onComplete: function () {
              var next = (cur + 1) % N;
              cur = -1;
              activate(next);
              startCycle();
            },
          });
        }
      }

      function stopCycle() {
        if (fillTween) {
          fillTween.kill();
          fillTween = null;
        }
      }

      function goTo(idx) {
        cur = -1;
        activate(idx);
        startCycle();
      }

      /* ── Build (called by matchMedia) ── */
      function build() {
        if (built) return;
        built = true;

        wraps.forEach(function (w) {
          if (w) gsap.set(w, { opacity: 1 });
        });
        fills.forEach(function (f) {
          if (f) gsap.set(f, { animation: 'none', width: '0%' });
        });
        gsap.set(details, { overflow: 'hidden', height: 0, opacity: 0 });
        gsap.set(img, { display: 'grid' });
        gsap.set(panes, { display: 'block', gridArea: '1 / 1', width: '100%', opacity: 0 });
        gsap.set(panes[0], { opacity: 1 });
        gsap.set(details[0], { height: 'auto', opacity: 1 });
        links.forEach(function (l, i) {
          gsap.set(l, { opacity: i === 0 ? 1 : 0.4 });
        });
        cur = 0;

        // ★ set initial chevron state (first tab rotated 180, rest at 0)
        chevrons.forEach(function (ch, i) {
          if (ch) gsap.set(ch, { rotation: i === 0 ? 180 : 0 });
        });

        /* Click handlers */
        links.forEach(function (l, i) {
          l.style.cursor = 'pointer';
          l.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            goTo(i);
          });
        });

        /* Start auto-cycle */
        startCycle();
      }

      var mm = gsap.matchMedia();
      mm.add('(min-width: 992px)', function () {
        build();
        return function () {
          stopCycle();
          built = false;
        };
      });
    }

    setup('');
    setup('b');
  })();
</script><script src="https://hubspotonwebflow.com/assets/js/form-124.js" type="text/javascript" integrity="sha384-bjyNIOqAKScdeQ3THsDZLGagNN56B4X2Auu9YZIGu+tA/PlggMk4jbWruG/P6zYj" crossorigin="anonymous"></script></body></html>
